title: Historical Writing Competition 2026 (demo)
description: DEMO DATA for showing the committee. Dates, word limits, entry limits, rubric and judges are placeholders.
_note: Declaration wording drafted from the spec; check it against the PDF 'QHTA Historical Writing Competition 2026 Entry Form'. Word limits are placeholders — set real ones per category per round.

config.privacy_notice: Most entrants are students under 18, so QHTA collects only the student's name, year level and school — no student contact details. All correspondence goes to the teacher. Entries are seen by QHTA administrators and judges; judges see the entry and its reference number only, not the student's name or school. For entries that are not awarded or commended, the student's details and the entry file are removed 12 months after the competition closes. Winning and commended entries may be published in QHTA's journal and/or website with the student's name and school. Contact qhta@qhta.com.au with any privacy questions.

fields.help: Entries are submitted by the student's teacher. We don't collect any student contact details; all correspondence goes to the teacher.

fields.label: Year level
fields.help: The category list shows only categories open to this year level.

fields.label: Teacher email
fields.help: We send the reference number and the outcome here.

fields.label: Entry document
fields.help: .docx or .pdf only, up to 10 MB. Do not put the student's name or school in the document — judging is anonymous.

fields.label: Word count
fields.help: Footnotes count towards the word count; the bibliography does not.

declarations.text: This entry is the student's original work, completed with no more than the usual level of teacher guidance.
The judges' decision is final and no correspondence will be entered into.
QHTA may publish this entry, with the student's name and school, in its journal and/or on its website.
I have the student's and parent/guardian's permission to submit this entry on these terms.
